## ALL LOW- AND MIDDLE-INCOME COUNTRIES — profile (page 113)

- Header facts:
  - Coverage: 119 countries
  - Population: 6,661 million
  - GNI: 40,164
  - Unit line: US$ billion, unless otherwise indicated
  - Region: not shown
  - Income group: not shown
  - Lending category: not shown
  - Data status: not shown

- Total external debt stock 2025 and change from 2024:
  - Total external debt stock, 2025: 9,445
  - Change from 2024: +5.5%

- Figure 1 Total external debt, 2015–25:
  - 2015: 5,916
  - 2025: 9,445
  - Line shape: rises overall from 2015 to 2025; increases steadily through the late 2010s, reaches a high around 2021 at ≈9.0 trillion, dips slightly in 2022, then edges up again in 2023–25 to a new peak in 2025.

- Figure 2 External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:
  - Total external debt: 9,445
    - Public & publicly guaranteed: 4,274
    - Private nonguaranteed: 2,746
    - Short-term: 2,424
  - Public & publicly guaranteed - by creditor type: 4,274
    - Multilateral: 1,494
    - Bilateral: 500
    - Private creditors: 2,281
  - Multilateral: 1,494
    - World Bank-IBRD: 269
    - IMF-SDR allocations: 240
    - Other multilateral: 985
  - Bilateral: 500
    - China: 144
    - Japan: 112
    - Other bilateral: 244

- Figure 3 Debt ratios:
  - External debt / exports: 88%, -1.2%
    - Trend: broadly flat to slightly rising through most of the period, with a spike around 2020, then declines and ends slightly below earlier levels by 2025.
  - External debt / GNI: 24%, +0.4%
    - Trend: fairly stable overall; modest increase to a local high around 2020, then eases and is nearly flat through 2025.
  - Debt service / exports: 13%, -4.7%
    - Trend: fluctuates; rises in the late 2010s to a peak around 2019–20, falls, has a small rebound, then declines again by 2025.
  - Debt service / GNI: 3%, -3.1%
    - Trend: low and fairly stable; small ups and downs across the period, ending slightly below recent highs by 2025.

- Figure 4 Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:
  - Official creditors:
    - Maturity: 24 yrs
    - Grace period: 6 yrs
    - Interest rate: 3.0%
  - Private creditors:
    - Maturity: 13 yrs
    - Grace period: 6 yrs
    - Interest rate: 5.7%

- Notes:
  - Figure 2 includes IMF credit and SDR allocations.
  - Figure 3 note: Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of all low- and middle-income DRS reporting countries.

- Source:
  - Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
